verdict.rationale: Runpod's own docs describe two official MCP servers that "connect AI tools and coding agents directly to Runpod." One manages Pods, endpoints, templates, volumes and registries through the REST API, with authentication via Sign in with Runpod or an API key. A probe confirms the MCP server documentation page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of an agent connecting, detail on the second server's scope, and client setup/configuration specifics.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Runpod provides two Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers that connect AI tools and coding agents directly to Runpod
Manage Pods, endpoints, templates, volumes, and registries through the Runpod REST API. Authenticate with Sign in with Runpod or a Runpod API key
